description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Config', which manages configuration directives for the HTML Purifier library, including methods for setting, getting, loading, finalizing configurations, and handling definitions. It is central to the configuration management within the HTML Purifier project.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Config
classes.description: The primary configuration class for the HTML Purifier library, providing methods to manage directives, load configurations from various sources, generate definitions, and handle configuration serialization and validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a configuration object from a configuration source, array, or filename.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Creates a new configuration object inheriting settings from an existing configuration.

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Creates a default configuration object based on the current schema.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration directive's value by key.

methods.name: getBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all directives within a specific namespace.

methods.name: getBatchSerial
methods.description: Returns a SHA-1 signature representing the current state of directives in a namespace.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns a SHA-1 signature representing the entire configuration's current state.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all directives organized by namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration directive.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads configuration directives from an associative array.

methods.name: loadIni
methods.description: Loads directives from an ini file.

methods.name: isFinalized
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has been finalized.

methods.name: autoFinalize
methods.description: Automatically finalizes the configuration if autoFinalize is enabled.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the configuration, preventing further modifications.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a definition object (HTML, CSS, URI), raw or optimized.

methods.name: maybeGetRawDefinition
methods.description: Returns a raw, unprocessed definition for a given type.

methods.name: loadArrayFromForm
methods.description: Loads configuration from form inputs stored in an array.

methods.name: mergeArrayFromForm
methods.description: Merges form input configuration into existing configuration.

methods.name: prepareArrayFromForm
methods.description: Prepares a form array into a structured configuration array.
